{{Quote|If you're on Corellia and you want the best shuttles, the best pilots, and the best prices, who do you comm?''"<br />"''Donoslane Excursions.|Kirney Slane and Voort saBinring, reciting the Donoslane Excursions advertisement|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Donoslane Excursions''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] company founded by former [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Myn Donos]] and Kirney Slane,<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> born "[[Gara Petothel]]" and also known as "Lara Notsil."<ref name="SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

Donoslane leased a section of [[Behareh Spaceport]] in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. The co-pilot aboard the manager's personal [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] was a [[Ewok/Legends|short, furry alien]].<ref name="LOTFB">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]], Kirney Slane used one of Donoslane's shuttles to rescue [[Wraith Squadron]] from [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although never made explicit in the novel, Donoslane takes its name from [[Myn Donos]] and [[Gara Petothel|Kirney Slane]], an alias [[Gara Petothel]] took after the destruction of the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], who author [[Aaron Allston]] has said got together after the events of ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''. The co-pilot of Kirney's shuttle, however, is obviously meant to be [[Kolot]].

Allston's implication regarding the ownership of the company was finally explicitly canonized in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', though Kolot's presence remains a mere implication.
